Start all bank workers, then the coordinator, using matching run ID, roster, rounds, epochs, timeout, broker and secret. The fixed schema must match on every laptop. Waiting for missing banks is bounded by the round timeout.

Stop/cancel affects this laptop only. Update published means broker delivery; coordinator verification and a bank's verified shared-model receipt are separate events. A coordinator completing a broadcast does not prove every bank received it.

Each private run uses ONE CausalTemporalGraphSAGE initialized from Sia's frozen seed-42 checkpoint. Only its 65,793 decoder coordinates adapt; all backbone coordinates stay frozen. Three banks perform four real private rounds, with three local epochs per June/July phase, lr=0.0003 and risk-context replay=2000. C=0.875, production multiplier=0.30, delta=1e-6; noisy-only FedAvg postprocessing uses server lr=0.1. Secure equal aggregation is mandatory; missing banks abort without plaintext fallback. No private ensemble or plaintext temporal harmonization is used. Reference ensemble training/scoring remains separate and nonprivate. Research seeds 42/52/62 are separate single-model runs, never ensemble members. Privacy is conditional on the nonprivate warm checkpoint and fixed public calibration; validation metrics are nonprivate disclosures.
